criteria_change_note: Since the 2026-06-06 baseline, two new hard filters were added: PSF must be BELOW S$1,700 (hard ceiling) and the unit must have MORE THAN 3 bedrooms (4BR+). All three baseline matches (The Line @ Tanjong Rhu 3BR, Bliss @ Kovan 2BR penthouse, Flamingo Valley 2BR) fail the new >3-bedroom filter; The Line also fails the new PSF ceiling ($2,054 psf).
data_quality_notes: Every property portal (PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp, Carousell) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct automated retrieval of search-result and listing pages this run. The agent proxy itself is healthy (no relay failures) — the 403s are portal-side bot blocks, identical to the 2026-06-06 run.

Web-search snippets surfaced PROJECT-level data only (e.g. Space @ Kovan 4BR ~1,625 sqft, 12-mo avg ~$1,694 psf; Kovan Jewel freehold 4BR luxury), but NO individual listing URL could be opened/verified live this run.

Per the non-negotiable rules, a listing whose URL cannot be opened/verified live must be DROPPED, and zero-result days must be reported plainly without padding or fabrication. Therefore no listings are reported tonight.

Spot-check on project-level economics confirms the bar is genuinely tight: a 4BR+ that is >1,000 sqft, priced $2.0-2.2M, AND below $1,700 psf implies roughly 1,180-1,294 sqft at the top of budget. Most freehold 4BR stock in D15/D19 is either larger (pushing well past $2.2M) or prices above the $1,700 psf ceiling.
